title: Ex 1.1 #5 · {x ∈ ℝ : x² = 3}
prompt: Write the set $\{x \in \mathbb{R} : x^2 = 3\}$ by listing its elements between braces.
answer_format: A set listed between braces, like {1, 2, 3} (∅ for the empty set). Steps are optional.
hints: The elements are the real solutions of the equation.
x² = 3 has two real solutions; don't forget the negative one.
solution: The equation x² = 3 has exactly two real solutions, x = √3 and x = −√3.

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words.
